import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

def get_title(url):
    try:
        # 发送请求，设置超时和请求头
        headers = {
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) '
                          'AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) '
                          'Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'
        }
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
        response.raise_for_status()  # 检查 HTTP 状态码
        
        # 自动识别编码（避免中文乱码）
        response.encoding = response.apparent_encoding
        
        # 解析 HTML
        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
        title = soup.title.string.strip() if soup.title else '无标题'
        return title
    
    except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
        return f'请求失败: {e}'


if __name__ == '__main__':
    url = 'https://www.python.org'
    print(f'网页标题: {get_title(url)}')
```

## 批量爬取多个网页

```python
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

HEADERS = {
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) '
                  'AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) '
                  'Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'
}

def fetch_title(url):
    try:
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=10)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        resp.encoding = resp.apparent_encoding
        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'html.parser')
        return url, soup.title.string.strip() if soup.title else '无标题'
    except Exception as e:
        return url, f'错误: {e}'


urls = [
    'https://www.python.org',
    'https://www.baidu.com',
    'https://www.github.com',
    'https://www.zhihu.com',
]

# 使用线程池并发爬取
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as executor:
    for url, title in executor.map(fetch_title, urls):
        print(f'{url} -> {title}')
```

## 关键点说明

| 要点 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **User-Agent** | 伪装成浏览器，避免被网站拒绝 |
| **timeout** | 防止请求卡死，建议设置 5~10 秒 |
| **raise_for_status()** | 遇到 4xx/5xx 状态码时抛出异常 |
| **apparent_encoding** | 自动识别编码，解决中文乱码问题 |
| **BeautifulSoup** | 解析 HTML，`soup.title.string` 获取标题文本 |
| **异常处理** | 捕获网络异常，避免程序崩溃 |

## 不依赖 BeautifulSoup 的版本

如果不想安装 `bs4`，可以用正则表达式：

```python
import re
import requests

def get_title_regex(url):
    headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    resp.encoding = resp.apparent_encoding
    match = re.search(r'<title[^>]*>(.*?)</title>', resp.text, re.S | re.I)
    return match.group(1).strip() if match else '无标题'

print(get_title_regex('https://www.python.org'))
```

pip install requests beautifulsoup4
